title: STHMoE: Hypergraph-Enhanced Heterogeneous Dependency Coordination for LLM-Based Urban Traffic Data Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.15172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatio-temporal traffic forecasting is a fundamental big data analytics task for intelligent transportation systems, where massive urban sensor streams exhibit heterogeneous, non-stationary, and structurally dynamic patterns. Although recent deep learning and large language model (LLM)-based methods have advanced traffic forecasting, they often remain temporally centered and lack effective coordination of temporal, spectral, pairwise spatial, and higher-order structural cues under evolving traffic regimes. To address this heterogeneous dependency coordination problem, we propose STHMoE, a Spatio-Temporal Hypergraph-Enhanced Mixture of Experts framework for urban traffic data forecasting. STHMoE decouples traffic dynamics into frequency-domain, time-domain, spatio-domain, and higher-order spatial representations, which are modeled by prompt-guided heterogeneous experts built upon a partially frozen LLM backbone. translated_title: STHMoE：面向基于大语言模型的城市交通数据预测的超图增强异构依赖协调框架
translated_abstract: 时空交通预测是智能交通系统中一项基础性的大数据分析任务，其中大规模城市传感器数据流呈现出异构、非平稳且结构动态变化的模式。尽管近年来基于深度学习和大规模语言模型（LLM）的方法推动了交通预测的发展，但它们往往以时间维度为中心，缺乏在交通状态演变过程中对时间、频谱、成对空间以及高阶结构线索的有效协调。为了解决这一异构依赖协调问题，我们提出了STHMoE，一个用于城市交通数据预测的时空超图增强专家混合（Mixture of Experts）框架。STHMoE将交通动态解耦为频域、时域、空间域以及高阶空间表示，这些表示由基于部分冻结的LLM骨干网络构建的提示引导异构专家进行建模。前三个专家……
tldr: STHMoE提出了一个基于部分冻结大语言模型的时空超图增强专家混合框架，通过将交通动态解耦为频域、时域、空间域和高阶空间四类表示并由提示引导的异构专家分别建模，有效协调了城市交通预测中的多源异构依赖。
en_tdlr: STHMoE introduces a spatio-temporal hypergraph-enhanced mixture-of-experts framework built on a partially frozen LLM backbone, which decouples traffic dynamics into frequency-domain, time-domain, spatial, and higher-order representations modeled by prompt-guided heterogeneous experts to coordinate diverse dependencies for urban traffic forecasting.
